purpose: Teach: 引き継ぐ/ジュエリー/賜物/見積り/雄大/摘出/要所/国税庁

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 創業期、本気で、絶対、お父さん、絶対、家業を、絶対、引き継ぐ、絶対、決意を、絶対、固めたぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: When this company was founded, my father made an absolute commitment to take over the family business. I'm asking you to honor that.
lines.style: Measured, gravitas-filled opening. Slow cadence. Pause after 'founded' — the weight of history settling. Firm on 'absolute commitment.' The voice of a man reflecting on what was passed to him.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんの代から、本気で、絶対、ジュエリー、絶対、扱う、絶対、誇り、絶対、を、絶対、持ってまいりました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Since my father's time, we have carried the pride of handling fine jewelry with complete sincerity. I'm grateful for that inheritance.
lines.style: Formal, respectful bow in the voice. Steady rhythm, each clause deliberate. Quieter on 'inheritance' — acknowledging receipt of something precious. No rushed energy.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さんの努力の、本気で、絶対、賜物、絶対、今の当社、絶対、あるぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: My father's hard work is the reason our company exists today. I want you to understand that.
lines.style: Quiet conviction. Slower tempo. Land firmly on 'exists today' — not rushing past the point. Slight upward lilt at the end, searching for acknowledgment. The voice of someone making sure the next generation listens.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんの代から、本気で、絶対、見積り、絶対、誠実に、絶対、出してまいりました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Since my father's time, we have submitted every quotation with complete honesty. I'm grateful for that foundation.
lines.style: Respectful, measured. Pause between 'quotation' and 'honesty' — letting the integrity breathe. Calm, professional tone. Warm but never informal. The voice of someone continuing a tradition.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、本気で、絶対、雄大、絶対、な夢、絶対、持っていたぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: My father held an ambitious vision. A grand dream for what this business could be. I want you to see that.
lines.style: Slower, more reflective. Slight wistfulness on 'held' — past tense, the dream now his to carry. Soft opening, building gently to 'grand dream.' Trailing slightly, inviting him to imagine it too.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんから、本気で、絶対、問題点、絶対、摘出、絶対、する、絶対、目、絶対、教えていただきました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. My father taught me how to see problems clearly — to identify what matters and what doesn't. I'm grateful for that eye.
lines.style: Tender, almost vulnerable admission. Slower pace. Gentle emphasis on 'taught me' — a moment of genuine thanks. The voice softens on 'grateful,' becoming almost personal. Not stiff, despite the formal register.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、本気で、絶対、商売の、絶対、要所、絶対、いつも、絶対、押さえていたぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: My father always knew where the pressure points were in business. He kept his hand on what mattered.
lines.style: Steady, observant tone. Measured pace. Slight pause before 'where' — considering the skill. Respect in every word, no condescension. The voice of a student who finally understands what the master was doing all along.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんの代から、本気で、絶対、国税庁、絶対、と、絶対、誠実に、絶対、向き合ってまいりました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Since my father's time, we have dealt with every authority honestly and straightforwardly. I'm grateful for that principle.
lines.style: Formal, composed closing statement. Even rhythm, professional but not cold. Slight emphasis on 'honestly' — the core value. Trailing gentle on 'principle' — the sentence lands like a bookmark closing a chapter.
